license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to engage in the business or profession of an auctioneer, apprentice auctioneer or an auction company to conduct an auction, to hold himself out as an auctioneer or as an apprentice auctioneer, to hold itself out as an auction company or to offer to conduct auctions in this Commonwealth without first obtaining a license from the board

issuing_authority.quote: "Board."  The State Board of Auctioneer Examiners.

name.quote: "Board."  The State Board of Auctioneer Examiners.

type.quote: The State Board of Auctioneer Examiners shall consist of the Commissioner of Professional and Occupational Affairs, the Director of the Bureau of Consumer Protection in the Office of Attorney General, or his designee, two members appointed by the Governor

umbrella_agency.quote: "Commissioner."  The Commissioner of Professional and Occupational Affairs in the Department of State.

moral_character_required.quote: Auctioneer, apprentice auctioneer and special auctioneer licenses shall be granted only to individuals who have a good reputation for honesty, truthfulness, integrity and competence to transact the business of an auctioneer or apprentice auctioneer in a manner as to safeguard the interest of the public

degree_required.value: Completion of a prescribed course of study in auctioneering at a Group A auction school (not less than 20 credit hours including 2 credit hours of practicum) or Group B auction school, or apprenticeship
degree_required.quote: successfully completing a prescribed course of study in auctioneering at a Group A auction school

accrediting_body.quote: "Group A auction school."  A provider, approved by the board, offering a course of study in auctioneering and the auction industry, as approved by the board

degree_level.quote: successfully completing a prescribed course of study in auctioneering at a Group A auction school

school_approval_basis.quote: A provider, approved by the board, offering a course of study in auctioneering and the auction industry, as approved by the board

credential_pegged.quote: successfully completing a prescribed course of study in auctioneering at a Group A auction school

required.quote: serving an apprenticeship as a licensed apprentice auctioneer for a period of not less than two years in the employ of a qualified sponsor and participating for compensation in no less than 30 auctions

experience_source.quote: serving an apprenticeship as a licensed apprentice auctioneer for a period of not less than two years in the employ of a qualified sponsor and participating for compensation in no less than 30 auctions

duration.value: not less than two years (apprenticeship path) or not less than one year (Group B school path)
duration.quote: serving an apprenticeship as a licensed apprentice auctioneer for a period of not less than two years in the employ of a qualified sponsor and participating for compensation in no less than 30 auctions

kind.quote: serving an apprenticeship as a licensed apprentice auctioneer for a period of not less than two years in the employ of a qualified sponsor

exams.name: Auctioneer examination
exams.notes: Board contracts with a professional testing organization for preparation and administration. Inactive license holders (7+ years) must pass exam before reissuance.
exams.jurisdiction: state board (administered by contracted professional testing organization)
exams.quote: no individual may be issued an auctioneer license unless the individual passes an examination approved by the board

interval_years.quote: All licenses issued by the board shall be for a maximum term of two years and shall expire on the last day of February of each odd year. It is the duty of all persons licensed to practice as an auctioneer, apprentice auctioneer or auction company to renew the license biennially with the board

available.quote: A person who is licensed in good standing as an auctioneer, apprentice auctioneer or auction company in another state may, on application to the board, be granted licensure as an auctioneer, apprentice auctioneer or auction company in this Commonwealth

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed in good standing in another state, pay application fee, file certified copy of out-of-state license, the other state's requirements must be commensurate with PA requirements, the other state must extend reciprocal rights to PA licensees, and applicant must satisfy all other PA requirements including furnishing a bond.
requirements.quote: provided that: (1) the requirements for licensure in the applicant's current licensing state are, in the determination of the board, commensurate with the requirements for licensure in this Commonwealth; (2) the licensing laws of the applicant's current licensing state extend to licensees of this Commonwealth the same reciprocal rights and privileges in that state without the necessity of the licensees in this Commonwealth to obtain additional or further licenses or authority from any political subdivision of that state; and (3) the applicant satisfies all other requirements of licensees and applicants for licensure in this Commonwealth, including the requirement to furnish a bond.

exists.quote: The State Board of Auctioneer Examiners shall consist of the Commissioner of Professional and Occupational Affairs, the Director of the Bureau of Consumer Protection in the Office of Attorney General, or his designee, two members appointed by the Governor with the advice and consent of the Senate, who shall be persons representing the public at large, one member appointed by the Governor with the advice and consent of the Senate, who shall be a registered trading assistant, and four members appointed by the Governor with the advice and consent of the Senate, each of whom is a licensed auctioneer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making any false promise of a character likely to influence, persuade or induce
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making any false promise of a character likely to influence, persuade or induce.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A continued or flagrant course of misrepresentation or making false promises through agents or apprentice auctioneers
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A continued or flagrant course of misrepresentation or making false promises through agents or apprentice auctioneers.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction within five years prior to issuance of current license for forgery, embezzlement, obtaining money under false pretenses, extortion, conspiracy to defraud or like offense
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Within five years prior to the issuance of the license then in force, conviction in a court of competent jurisdiction in this or any other state or in Federal court of forgery, embezzlement, obtaining money under false pretenses, extortion, conspiracy to defraud or other like offense or offenses.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any failure to account for or to pay over moneys belonging to others which have come into possession arising out of a sales transaction within a reasonable time
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any failure to account for or to pay over moneys belonging to others which have come into his or its possession arising out of a sales transaction within a reasonable time.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any act or conduct in connection with a sales transaction which demonstrates incompetency, bad faith or dishonesty
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any act or conduct in connection with a sales transaction which demonstrates incompetency, bad faith or dishonesty.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly using false bidders, cappers or puffers
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly using false bidders, cappers or puffers.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any of the provisions of this act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any of the provisions of this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any regulation of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any regulation of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having license to engage in auction profession revoked, suspended, or other disciplinary action or application refused by another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having his license to engage in the auction profession revoked or suspended or having other disciplinary action taken or his application for licensure refused, revoked or suspended by the proper licensing authority of another state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a licensee or registrant who receives moneys on account of others to establish or maintain an escrow account as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure of a licensee or registrant who receives moneys on account of others to establish or maintain an escrow account as required in section 21.

disciplinary_grounds.description: For any licensed auctioneer or apprentice auctioneer to bid and buy for himself at any auction he is conducting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For any licensed auctioneer or apprentice auctioneer to bid and buy for himself at any auction he is conducting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying compensation to any person other than a licensee or registrant for rendering services that only licensees or registrants may perform
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For any licensee or registrant to pay any compensation in money or other valuable thing to any person other than a licensee or registrant for the rendering of any service or the doing of any of the acts by this act forbidden to be rendered or performed by other than licensees or registrants.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising an auction or online trading assistant consignment sale without including the name and license or registration number of the licensee or registrant
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For a licensee or registrant to advertise an auction or a sale through an online trading assistant consignment sale without including in the advertisement or notice of sale the name and the license or registration number of the licensee or registrant conducting the transaction.

bonding_required.quote: No license, including a special license, or registration shall be granted or issued to any person under this act until the applicant has filed with the board an approved bond payable to the Commonwealth in the amount of $5,000.

definition_quote.value: An individual who sells or offers or attempts to sell property at auction. The term includes an individual who: (1) Engages in or offers the calling for and recognition of bids at auction. (2) Engages in or offers any of the activities of an auction company. (3) Performs, or offers to perform, any of the functions or activities requiring licensure under section 3(a)(1). (4) Holds himself out as engaged in the business of selling property at auction.
definition_quote.quote: "Auctioneer."  An individual who sells or offers or attempts to sell property at auction.

methods_authorized.quote: Licensees under this act shall be authorized to conduct auctions at any venue within this Commonwealth, including on-site auctions and auctions held at auction houses and temporary venues, and by any method of conducting the sale, including live auctions and online auctions and auctions that are conducted live and online contemporaneously, whether real-time auctions or extended auctions.

license_tiers.quote: "Licensee."  An individual licensed under this act as an auctioneer, apprentice auctioneer or holder of a special license and a legally recognized entity licensed under this act as an auction company.

apprentice_sponsor_required.quote: To qualify for an apprentice auctioneer license, an individual must be sponsored and employed for compensation by a qualified sponsor who employs no more than one other apprentice auctioneer.

apprentice_sponsor_max_apprentices.quote: an individual must be sponsored and employed for compensation by a qualified sponsor who employs no more than one other apprentice auctioneer.

apprenticeship_minimum_auctions.quote: participating for compensation in no less than 30 auctions, including auctions under the supervision of a substitute qualified sponsor

auction_school_groups.quote: "Group A auction school."  A provider, approved by the board, offering a course of study in auctioneering and the auction industry, as approved by the board, the completion of which requires not less than 20 credit hours, including two credit hours of practicum or cooperative practical experience. "Group B auction school."  A provider, approved by the board, offering a course of study in auctioneering and the auction industry, as approved by the board, the completion of which requires fewer than 20 credit hours.

auction_school_minimum_credit_hours.quote: the completion of which requires not less than 20 credit hours, including two credit hours of practicum or cooperative practical experience.

practicum_hours_required.quote: the completion of which requires not less than 20 credit hours, including two credit hours of practicum or cooperative practical experience.

special_license_available.quote: An auctioneer or auction company authorized to engage in auctioneering in another state shall, on application and payment of the license fee, be issued a special license for each specifically identified auction to be conducted in this Commonwealth.

special_license_advance_notice_days.quote: Applications must be made not less than 20 days in advance of the auction or sale at auction

auction_company_auctioneer_of_record_req.quote: Every auction company shall designate an auctioneer-of-record. Each auction company licensed under this act shall designate an individual licensed as an auctioneer under this act to serve as the auction company's auctioneer-of-record.

auction_company_auctioneer_of_record_not.quote: Within 30 calendar days after an auction company's auctioneer-of-record ceases to serve as auctioneer-of-record for the auction company, both the auction company and the auctioneer-of-record or the auctioneer-of-record's legal representative shall notify the board in writing of the termination of such status.

surety_bond_required.quote: No license, including a special license, or registration shall be granted or issued to any person under this act until the applicant has filed with the board an approved bond payable to the Commonwealth in the amount of $5,000.

surety_bond_amount.quote: the applicant has filed with the board an approved bond payable to the Commonwealth in the amount of $5,000.

escrow_account_required.quote: Every licensee and registrant shall promptly deposit moneys, received from the sale of property, belonging to others in a separate custodial or trust fund account maintained by the licensee or registrant until the transaction involved is terminated

written_contract_required.quote: Prior to conducting a transaction, a licensee or registrant shall enter into a written contract, in duplicate, with the owner or consignor of the property to be sold, containing the terms and conditions upon which the licensee or registrant agrees to conduct the sale.

records_retention_years.quote: The written records shall be kept on file in the office of the licensee or registrant for a period of not less than two years

license_display_required.quote: Every licensee and registrant under this act shall prominently display the certificate of licensure or registration at the licensee's or registrant's office, and the current wallet card or any facsimile thereof issued to the licensee or registrant shall be shown on demand of any person at all auctions or sales at auction conducted by any licensee

advertisement_must_include_license_numbe.quote: For a licensee or registrant to advertise an auction or a sale through an online trading assistant consignment sale without including in the advertisement or notice of sale the name and the license or registration number of the licensee or registrant conducting the transaction.

online_trading_assistant_registration_re.quote: It shall be unlawful for an individual to act as a trading assistant, or for any legally recognized entity to act as a trading assistant company, without either first registering with or obtaining licensure from the board.

auction_format_types_authorized.quote: The term "auction" or "sale at auction" includes: (i) live auctions; (ii) online auctions; (iii) real-time auctions; (iv) extended auctions; (v) any similar such events as may be devised with the development of technology; and (vi) any combination of the foregoing.

value: Specified single sale per year by the owner of property not engaged in the business of selling and owning property in individual capacity
Sale by or on behalf of a charitable organization where the conductor receives no compensation
Sale by or on behalf of a person appointed by judicial order or decree
Sale in settlement of a decedent's estate by the executor or administrator
Sale by or under the direction of any public authority
Sale required by law to be at auction
license_exemptions.quote: The requirement to obtain a license under this act does not apply to sales at auction in the following circumstances

inactive_license_reexamination_threshold.quote: Any individual to whom an auctioneer license has been issued and whose license has been in an inactive or nonrenewed status for a period of seven or more years shall be required to submit to and pass an examination approved by the board prior to having a license reissued.

post_revocation_reapplication_waiting_ye.quote: After the revocation of any license or registration, no new license or registration may be requested by or issued to the same licensee or registrant within a period of at least five years from the date of the revocation

self_bidding_prohibited.quote: For any licensed auctioneer or apprentice auctioneer to bid and buy for himself at any auction he is conducting.

shill_bidding_prohibited.quote: Knowingly using false bidders, cappers or puffers.
